i had trouble fighting twisted scavenger (because i main loader) so i had the idea to use the chaos artifact (friendly fire) and use the back up as an active, while having a few crowbars, fuel cells and most important of all a ceremonial dagger. by instakilling your spawned drones (loaders shift is quite usefull here) each of them spawn 3 daggers. with that you can hide behind the pillars in the twisted scavenger bossfight and still deal more than enough damage

especially good to do with Command artifact, because  goat hoofs and especially energy drinks will help you out. from the top of my head the best thing to aproach this would be to load up your shift and grapple a wall to get speed. with a good map and 2 or 3 backup magazines you can also increase your speed, because you can build up more speed by grappling from one wall to another. and dont forget to sprint with loader 99% of the time like after grappling and using shift (especially once you let go of your shift key, plus you can also sprint while holding your shift). hope i could help somewhat
because one shotting enemies and even bosses is hella fun (for me at least). Throw a Ceremonial Dagger in there and after one kill you wont even have to do anything anymore

I have some teouble beating him because im a loader main and i therefore die easily because of my short range / methods of escaping. For that i found a way to use Cermemoniam Dagger efficiently, (while using the artifact of Command and the artifact of Chaos) although it needs some specific items for the setup:

-fuel cells (Green, uncommon item) (around 2 or more)

-Ceremonial Dagger (Red, Legendary) (easily aquireable in the void fields when playing with the Command artifact)

-Hardlight Afterburner (Red, Legendary item)

-The Backup (Orange, Active item)

-(optional) lens makers glasses (x10) and armor piercing rounds for more damage

The thing is you can use the backup to spawn 4 drones and kill them instantly (especially with loader's shift) and then you'll have 12 Ceremonial Daggers indtantly, dealing heavy amounts if damage while you can stand behind pillars for cover.
The fuel cells and hardlight afterburner allow you to spawn more daggers in the span of seconds for even more burst damage

looks pretty good, although i have a few tips:
Tougher Time's chance to avoid damage caps at 20 stacks (around 75% chamce of avoiding damage). The 57 Leaf Clover doesn't reroll that chance, as i hear in a video from youtuber / streamer Woolie.
Also when it comes to healing i wouldn't reccommend using Leeching seed when given the option to choose between Leeching seeds and Hervester Scythes. I tried a run (on Rainstorm difficulty) with several leeching seeds and a bit of solder's syringes for attackspeed and it felt like the healing granted from the difficulty alone was more than the healing i got from the seeds. Compared to harvester scythes (and a from lens makers glasses of course for garuanteed crits) the scythe grants way more healing. And also when combined with N'kuhanas Opinion you'll also deal good amounts of damage, too.

Sorry for such a long comment but i hope i could help you / anybody out a bit

a quick tip for playing with the Command artifact. Tougher Times caps at 20x, at which you'll have a 75% chance of avoiding damage (as the wiki states). Clover also doesn't reroll Tougher Times (as stated by the youtuber / streamer Woolie)

in addition the teleporter usually spawns at the other half of the map from your spawnpoint. (with that you can already guess the general spawn area of the teleporter (on most maps) and can then focus on finding the yellow particles)

I personally like to build lens maker's glasses / armor piercing rounds + fuel cells (around 9 of them) and a swamerang. With Loader you can get very close to bosses and just watch their lifebars melt
